articles.title: Jupiter: The Solar System's Biggest Bully with a Heart of Swirling Gas
articles.summary: Jupiter isn't just a planet—it's a failed star with a storm wider than Earth. Its moon Europa might harbor life in a hidden ocean. But don't get too close: radiation levels are over a thousand times lethal.

articles.title: Canada: A Land So Vast It Has Six Time Zones and More Lakes Than People
articles.summary: Canada is the world's second-largest country but has only 0.5% of the global population. It holds 20% of Earth's fresh water and spans from Arctic tundra to prairie grasslands. Yet Quebec nearly left—twice.

articles.title: How Will Sharpe's 'Outsider Energy' Brought Mozart to Life in 'Amadeus'
articles.summary: Actor Will Sharpe channels his own experience of never quite fitting in to play Mozart as a socially awkward genius. He spent months learning piano and conducting to capture the composer's daily struggle. The Starz series reimagines the Mozart-Salieri rivalry.
